digest.component_or_area: binding store persistence and selective tickets-branch publication
propositions: Publication must stage only the existing five bridge-state files; repository checkpoints must not independently publish
Unchanged passes create no commit; GET rotation and retired-first failure cases preserve pre-extraction publication and recovery floors
Repository delegation ownership, ordered partial-state behavior, selective publication semantics, rollback logic, and explicit no-journal/no-format-migration decisions must be documented in ADR 0099
Regression test suite covering selective commit staging, unchanged passes, rotation, and retired-state publication must pass through the delegating facade unchanged
Repository failures must not cause unrelated tracker staging; local persistence remains distinct from tickets-branch publication
